registration.title: Marking down clubs with no league in the data
registration.what: Take 25 points off a side that has no league in the database when it meets one that has.
registration.why: Clubs known only from cup ties looked overrated in every period.
registration.how: One number, chosen on 2023/24, applied to those matches.
registration.hypothesis: Sides with no league are overrated by a fixed amount.
registration.success_criteria: The standing bar: result log loss better by at least 0.002 on held-out matches, with the interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing and the same direction in each season. Over all matches. A second bar on the changed matches alone asked for the same direction on test and holdout.

events.label: One-sided matches, July 2024 onwards
events.meaningful: Points the right way; the interval just includes zero.

events.label: One-sided matches, 2021/22 and 2022/23
events.meaningful: No. Nothing on the unseen seasons.

events.reason: The direction is the same in every period but the size is too uncertain to set.
